reward_contract.component_range: all quality components are finite [0,1]; collision and out_of_road are per-candidate indicators
reward_contract.continuous_risk_timeline: 0.0 through 4.0 seconds inclusive at 0.1-second spacing in both proxy and resampled executed-trace domains
reward_contract.continuous_risk_aggregation: per-background-actor alternative-branch max, then per-time interaction max, then 0.7*time_max + 0.3*time_mean
reward_contract.physical_event_semantics: raster-filled physical footprint plus nominal background branch; collision/out penalties are additive and never replace the remaining candidate score
reward_contract.tracking_risk_semantics: tracking-aware footprint plus reachable background alternatives contributes only continuous gap, TTC and road-margin risk
reward_contract.unsafe_semantics: diagnostic only; never controls reward, action selection, optimizer update, or best-checkpoint ordering
reward_contract.legacy_compatibility: legacy GRPO checkpoints remain readable only through the explicit read-only evaluation path; no silent migration, optimizer restoration, online resume, or run_3 resume

grpo_open_application_contract.advantage_baseline: same-live-state deterministic frozen Stage1 raw tau_d proxy reward
grpo_open_application_contract.advantage_normalization: delta divided by per-group delta RMS plus epsilon; no group-mean centering or positive clamp
grpo_open_application_contract.accepted_group_condition: raw reward span greater than 1e-6 and max(reward-frozen_pretrain_reward) greater than pretrain_improvement_margin
grpo_open_application_contract.rejected_group_side_effects: no trajectory optimization, RuleMaker finalize, policy update, accepted-budget or validation progress, or environment step
grpo_open_application_contract.exhausted_state_fallback: optimize and finalize the frozen-pretrain tau_d trajectory, then execute it once without a policy update

optimizer_contract.behavior_policy_snapshot: detached sampled mode and stochastic DDIM-transition log probabilities captured before any policy update
optimizer_contract.mode_ratio_factorization: one ratio per joint sampled mode group entry [B,G]
optimizer_contract.trajectory_ratio_factorization: one ratio per stochastic DDIM transition [B,G,S]
optimizer_contract.advantage_baseline: same-live-state deterministic frozen Stage1 raw tau_d proxy reward with shape [B,1]
optimizer_contract.advantage_normalization: (reward-frozen_pretrain_reward) divided by per-group delta RMS plus epsilon; no group-mean centering
optimizer_contract.advantage_reuse: pretrain-relative RMS-normalize once, detach, and freeze across all epochs of the accepted rollout
optimizer_contract.rollout_consumption: one external update call consumes one accepted live rollout and performs exactly update_epochs serial optimizer steps
optimizer_contract.minibatch_semantics: none; reuse the complete joint group each epoch
optimizer_contract.reference_regularization: recompute behavior-cloning and frozen-Stage1 reference KL every epoch
optimizer_contract.checkpoint_boundary: after a complete rollout and all of its optimizer epochs

rollout_collection_contract.budget_allocation: deterministically balance the accepted pretrain-improving rollout-group target across ordered scenario-by-seed buckets; lower bucket indices receive any remainder
rollout_collection_contract.attempt_budget: attempted candidate groups are globally capped at max_attempted_groups_multiplier times the accepted-group target
rollout_collection_contract.same_state_retry: infer frozen pretrain once per live state and sample at most max_candidate_groups_per_state current-policy groups while advancing only the training generator
rollout_collection_contract.acceptance_gate: max(reward-frozen_pretrain_reward) > pretrain_improvement_margin and raw reward span > 1e-6
rollout_collection_contract.rejected_candidate_side_effects: none except training-generator advance and one sampling-attempt event
rollout_collection_contract.fallback_after_state_rejection: after local exhaustion, optimize and RuleMaker-finalize the cached frozen-pretrain trajectory and perform one env.step without update
rollout_collection_contract.rollout_start: At the first history-ready and primary-scenario-ready state t_ready, draw one inclusive uniform integer offset from the shared training torch.Generator before policy sampling; the upper bound is min(200, environment_steps_per_episode - t_ready - 10).
rollout_collection_contract.rollout_start_rng_draws: exactly one per feasible live training episode, including an upper bound of zero
rollout_collection_contract.late_target_retry: If the sampled target is not reached before scenario-window closure or natural episode end, close and retry the same bucket visit with a temporary upper bound tightened to the observed last-open offset; clear it after the first accepted rollout.
rollout_collection_contract.partial_visit_policy: Retain every completed rollout and optimizer update; if the scenario window or episode ends mid-visit, resume the remaining visit in a new episode with a fresh offset.
rollout_collection_contract.validation_start: fixed validation remains earliest-ready and never consumes a random start offset
rollout_collection_contract.episode_reuse: after the randomized start, collect consecutive accepted rollout groups or frozen-pretrain fallback steps from successive scenario-valid states in the same live MetaDrive episode
rollout_collection_contract.per_group_order: cache one frozen-pretrain baseline for the live state, attempt up to three G-entry behavior-policy groups, and only for the first accepted group finish all optimizer epochs then execute its selected tau_cmd with exactly one env.step
rollout_collection_contract.segment_boundaries: close the live environment only at natural termination or truncation, environment_steps_per_episode, the bucket-visit quota, the bucket final target, the next validation rollout boundary, or the total rollout budget
rollout_collection_contract.rule_maker_commitment: within a live episode, advance active committed execution and condition on committed actions before allowing a new proposal; preserve exact feedback compatibility and safe-STOP behavior
rollout_collection_contract.resume_boundary: validation and checkpoints occur only after the live environment is closed; do not serialize in-flight environment, sample-builder history, or RuleMaker commitment state
rollout_collection_contract.legacy_resume: checkpoints without this exact collection contract and its sampler state are not resumable

stage2_common_contract.optimizer_semantics: For the first accepted joint group, freeze its old log-probabilities and pretrain-relative RMS advantages, then perform four serial PPO steps with ratio clipped to [0.9,1.3]; rejected groups perform none.
stage2_common_contract.environment_semantics: Never step the G candidates as G MetaDrive branches. Under stage2_joint_grpo_persistent_episode_v3, retries stay on the same live state; an accepted group or a three-rejection frozen-pretrain fallback sends exactly one finalized tau_cmd to one MetaDrive env.step().

main_comparisons: Stage1-A versus GRPO-Open: benefit of Stage 2 open-loop refinement

metric_groups: safety: joint/per-agent collision and out-of-road x/n; shared-corridor 5m/7m gap violations, exposure, minimum gap, and deficit integral; TTC<1.5s observation, minimum TTC, maximum DRAC, and execution rejection
efficiency: scenario realized, functional success final/ever/stable, stable-success time, navigation route progress, team mean/min progress, completion time, and descriptive episode duration
cooperation: formation-locked target-spacing error, locked speed spread, unlock count/duration, relock recovery success/time, and censored recovery count
comfort: physical longitudinal/lateral acceleration, longitudinal jerk, yaw rate, and yaw acceleration; throttle/steering command slew remains diagnostic
realtime: BEV, model, RuleMaker, optimizer, control mapping, and complete planning-tick P50/P95 plus complete-tick P99/max/>200ms fraction
formal_evaluation.comparison_statistics: Episode-first aggregation; binary x/n with two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson intervals; continuous equal-weight S5-S9 scenario macro means; strict (scenario, route, seed) paired deltas with 10000-sample fixed-seed scenario-stratified bootstrap 95% intervals; REPEATS verifies reproducibility and never expands the statistical sample.
formal_evaluation.comparison_interpretation: Report metric values, candidate-minus-baseline deltas, sample counts, units, direction, and 95% intervals. Do not publish a weighted composite score or an overall-better verdict; episode duration is descriptive rather than directionally favorable.
formal_evaluation.latency_gate: The v2 RuleMaker-conditioned three-vehicle complete planning-tick P95 must be no greater than 200 ms. No v1 inference gate remains in the active training/evaluation contract.
formal_evaluation.optional_secondary_ablation: Inside GRPO-Exec only, compare surrogate ensemble mean against mean plus uncertainty-aware reward after the three-model main matrix is complete. This is not a Stage1 A/B ablation.
